title: The Vanishing at Morrow Creek
subtitle: Reopened March 2026 — Assigned to you, Detective

stages.detectiveNote: New case on my desk. Woman disappeared from a cabin near Morrow Creek back in '97. Start with the case briefing — get the basics down. Then listen to that 911 call. Something about the caller's voice doesn't sit right with me...

Something about Diane's story doesn't sit right. She says she saw the car at 10pm, but the 911 call didn't come in until 11:42. That's almost two hours. What was she doing in that gap? Look at her statement again...
stages.dispatchMessage: Detective [NAME] — for the record, we need you to confirm: what time was the emergency call placed? Check the transcript and submit your answer to unlock the phone records.
stages.question: What time was the 911 call placed?
hints: The time is mentioned in the 911 call evidence...
Listen to the recording again — the dispatcher states the exact time at the start.
The call came in late at night. The time starts with 11...

stages.detectiveNote: The phone records show Webb called the cabin THREE times that night. But he told investigators he hadn't spoken to her in weeks. He's lying. I found what looks like an old social media profile for him — need to check it out...
stages.dispatchMessage: Detective [NAME] — forensic lab left results for you. The authorization code was stamped on the original evidence bag — it's visible in one of the crime scene photos. Find it and submit it to access the report.

stages.detectiveNote: The forensic report changes everything. There were two sets of prints at the cabin, and one of them doesn't match anyone we've interviewed yet. Who else was there that night?
